nodes.description: In the developing cochlea TRIM71 holds hair cell progenitors in a proliferative, undifferentiated state by restricting TGF-beta-type signaling (Inhba, Tgfbr2). Without it, hair cells form and are innervated too early, and in adult mice presynaptic terminals are reduced and neurons degenerate in the outer hair cell region.
